# CBS Finance Institute

> SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation, expert training and digital playbooks for CFOs, finance leaders and SAP consultants.

CBS Finance Institute is a French consulting and training institute specialized in SAP Finance (FICO, RE-FX) and AI-driven finance transformation. We help enterprises modernize their finance function on SAP S/4HANA through three pillars: expert advisory, premium training programs, and ready-to-use digital products.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of CBS Finance Institute — SAP Finance transformation, training and digital products.
- [Formations](/formations): Premium SAP Finance & AI training catalog — FICO Consultant Program, automation modules, and RE-FX specialization.
- [SAP FICO Consultant Program](/formations/sap-fico-consultant-program): Flagship program to become an operational SAP FICO consultant.
- [Offres Entreprise](/offres-entreprise): Tailored corporate offers — Key User programs, transformation sprints and SAP Finance advisory.
- [Produits digitaux](/produits-digitaux): Digital playbooks, configuration kits and templates for SAP Finance teams.
- [Ressources](/ressources): Articles, guides and resources on SAP Finance transformation.
- [À propos](/a-propos): Mission, expertise and team behind CBS Finance Institute.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with our SAP Finance experts.
